command: find . -name "influx.yaml" -type f
ls -la
cat influx.yaml
kubectl get statefulsets -n telemetry-3e02
kubectl get statefulsets -n telemetry-3e02 influx -o yaml | head -80
kubectl exec -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0 -- cat /data/payload.txt
kubectl apply -f influx.yaml -n telemetry-3e02
kubectl set env statefulset/influx -n telemetry-3e02 MODE=b
kubectl get pod -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0
sleep 3 && kubectl get pod -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0
kubectl exec -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0 -- printenv MODE
kubectl exec -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0 -- cat /data/payload.txt
kubectl get pvc -n telemetry-3e02
kubectl patch pvc data-influx-0 -n telemetry-3e02 --type merge -p '{"spec":{"resources":{"requests":{"storage":"128Mi"}}}}'
kubectl get pvc -n telemetry-3e02 data-influx-0
kubectl get statefulset influx -n telemetry-3e02 -o yaml | grep -A 20 "volumeClaimTemplates:"
kubectl get statefulset influx -n telemetry-3e02 -o yaml | grep -A 5 "env:"
kubectl exec -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0 -- ls -la /data && kubectl exec -n telemetry-3e02 influx-0 -- cat /data/payload.txt
